g.text: A structure-inclusive SVR lands near the published RMSE; composition-only SVRs are higher, symbolic B far higher

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: tehrani150 uses the 150 features shipped with the dataset (18 structure-derived, not composition-only); scored on our grouped val split, not on theirs.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Caption. Protocol differs: the published numbers are Tehrani et al. (2018)'s 10-fold cross-validation on n = 2572 moduli (fold grouping not described in the paper); ours

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: are single-split, element-set-grouped val, n = 374, so identical RMSE would not mean identical difficulty. The published model uses 14 structural descriptors among its

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: 150, so it is not composition-only; only our Magpie and tehrani_comp arms are. RMSE and R² are exploratory diagnostics (not among the pre-registered Hv metrics), used

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: here because the paper reports them. Bars: RMSE, whiskers: 95% cluster bootstrap (2000 draws over element-set groups; for the 3-seed symbolic bar, the mean over the

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: seeds' RMSEs). The symbolic Magpie-only equation is the lowest-val-MAE one within c<=15 (optimistic); there are no symbolic G runs. The paper reports no MAE for B or G,

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: so none is compared. No published error is shown for Hv, and none of our hv_chen errors is compared with a measured-Hv error.
